E.state: BUY episode starts at close <= EMA20 in bullish EMA regime; after signal rearm only at close > EMA20, then next pullback. Mirror for SELL. No session reset; skipped regular bars update state. No signal is backfilled on skipped bars.

F.range: High/low extrema of exactly the completed 09:15, 09:20, 09:25 regular bars; all three required.
F.state: Earliest eligible bar start 09:30, completed at 09:35; execution next physical 09:35 bar open. Direction budget consumed on signal (one attempt); runner guards ensure every emitted validation signal enters. If any F signal fails to enter, stop for review. Budgets reset each session.

G.state: BUY rearms only at close >= VWAP, SELL only at close <= VWAP; reset both at session start. Extrema use all completed regular bars so far including current. Skipped bars update extrema and resets without backfilled signals.
G.limitation: The supplied extreme filter is nonbinding for valid OHLC and positive ATR; preserved literally, without an added continuation filter.

methodology.indicators: Unchanged production indicator implementations: EMA20/50, rolling RSI14, rolling ATR14, VolumeSMA20, cumulative close-times-volume / volume session VWAP. Rolling indicators continue across sessions; VWAP resets each session.
methodology.execution: Unchanged BacktestRunner and BacktestEngine: completed N signal, physical N+1 open, signal ATR, stop 1.5 ATR, target 2 ATR, adverse 5bps each leg, gaps before range, intrabar STOP wins, sole closure _close_position, EOD/no overnight.
methodology.risk: Initial INR 100000, 1% capital distance-to-stop sizing, INR 2000 daily loss latch, max five trades/session, unchanged charges/cutoffs/session policy v2.
methodology.slices: Same Phase14B attribution: 62 sessions Mar09-Jun10; 63 Jun11-Sep08; no reruns or resets. Actual carried capital, local realized-equity peak at slice start. Legacy 98 / CAS 27.
methodology.concentration: Rank profitable sessions by positive session net and losing sessions by most negative session net. Report gross winning-trade contributions in best five / full gross profit; absolute gross losing-trade contributions in worst five / full gross loss. Also provide netted session gross contributions and denominators. Best-five net / total net is signed; absolute denominator share and net excluding best five are also reported. Zero denominators => null.
methodology.concentration_flag: Flag if top-five gross-profit share > 50%, top-five gross-loss share > 50%, or positive full net becomes nonpositive excluding best five sessions.
methodology.classification: Zero correctness violations required before any classification. Fewer than 30 trades => INSUFFICIENT SAMPLE. Gross <= 0 with PF < 1 => REJECT. Candidate requires positive gross and net, PF >= 1, at least 30 trades, DD < 30%, both halves and both policy periods gross-positive with >=10 trades each, and no concentration flag. Other gross-positive cases => RESEARCH FURTHER. No production-ready class.
methodology.caveats: No parameter search. One instrument and one in-sample history, limited tails and CAS coverage. Realized-equity DD excludes intrabar mark-to-market. Side buckets are attribution, not separately sized strategy runs.

comparison_answers.Did any achieve PF >= 1?: No. Gross PF E 0.58, F 0.61, G 0.48.
comparison_answers.Did any reduce DD without eliminating al: All three have lower DD than A with non-trivial samples (92/142/248 trades over 65/115/125 active sessions). E alone improves on D: 39.02% versus 45.22%, with 92 versus 130 trades. Reduced frequency and different capital paths confound causal attribution; none demonstrates profitable entry edge. F DD 51.68% and G DD 80.15% remain severe.
comparison_answers.Is performance stable across both halves: There is no stable profitability: every family is gross- and net-negative in both halves. E gross PF improves 0.54 to 0.64; F deteriorates 0.71 to 0.49; G deteriorates 0.50 to 0.42.
comparison_answers.Is performance stable across legacy and: Every family is gross- and net-negative in both regimes. E CAS has only 18 trades, F 30, G 55; apparent regime differences are not evidence of an edge or a causal policy effect.
comparison_answers.Is profitability dependent on one side o: No profitable side exists. Both sides are gross- and net-negative in every family. BUY is weaker than SELL by PF, win rate and average net trade for E/F/G. No side was removed.
comparison_answers.Is the result overly concentrated?: No family triggers the predeclared concentration rule. Best five profitable sessions contribute 25.11% / 12.98% / 22.30% of gross winning-trade profits; worst five contribute 20.34% / 13.81% / 10.19% of gross losses for E/F/G. This does not mitigate broad negative expectancy or limited tail coverage.

recommended_next_step: Preregister a research-only diagnostic of the saved entry events using fixed forward-return horizons, MAE/MFE and slippage/charge attribution, with no parameter search, side removal, exit changes or additional backtest variants. Use it to understand the common failure mechanism and require a distinct economic hypothesis before proposing another canonical experiment; none of E/F/G should advance as a held-out candidate.
